[[File:SolarPhoenix2.jpg|230px|thumb|An Imperial outpost at Solar Phoenix 2, patrolled by TIE Fighters and TIE Bombers]]
'''Solar Phoenix 2''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] which was a hotspot for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]] and deadly activity. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] point of operations against [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|band of loyal thugs]]. It was imperative to use caution when careening through this area. The Empire maintained a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the region.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Solar Phoenix 2 was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
